title: Special Executive Programme In Operations Management
description: Enhance your expertise in operations management to drive efficiency and effectiveness in business activities.
longDescription: This Special Executive Programme provides a comprehensive understanding of operations management, covering essential topics such as inventory management, supply chain strategies, and quality assurance. Participants will learn to implement best practices in waste management and recycling, equipping them to optimize operational processes in their organizations.
courseDetails: Define inventory and its types. Identify commonly used items. Understand effective inventory management techniques. Explore waste management practices. Understand recycling processes and strategies. Recognize the benefits of waste management for businesses. Define Human Supply Chain Management. Understand critical elements and strategies. Learn about distribution channels and return management. Understand quality control processes and methods. Explore statistical process control techniques. Learn about ISO 9000 standards and the Kaizen philosophy. The programme defines operations management and its critical functions while highlighting its significance in overall business activities. Participants will explore inventory management techniques, including types of inventory and effective control methods. Key topics such as waste management practices and recycling strategies will be examined for their benefits to businesses. Additionally, the course covers supply chain management and quality assurance processes, including ISO standards and the Kaizen philosophy to enhance operational excellence. After successful completion of this course you will learn the following: Role of Operations in Business Activities Inventory Management Recycling and Waste Management Supply Chain Management Quality assurance and control
